description: Response of Adjacent Buildings to Blast and Collapse Induced Ground Motions is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Christine Wittich, University of Nebraska Lincoln (unl.edu). Three structures were monitored during a nearby controlled implosion of two 13-story reinforced concrete buildings. The controlled implosion included localized blasts on alternate floor levels, which initiated the progressive collapse of the buildings. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: collapse, soil-structure interaction, blast, building. Published 2020-02-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
